_comment: Scene for the task force composition editor and the ship class picker that opens with it. Keys are explained in tools/scenes/fleet.json and wiki/Game-Recipes.md.

windows.name: task_force_composition_editor_window
windows._note: Centred in its file, but the code opens it beside the composition button it was opened from (Engine Facts S22). Its height is 161 plus 43 per row. The code moves Cancel and OK below the last row.

windows.name: task_force_composition_editor_sub_unit_selection_window
windows._note: The code puts it at sub_unit_selection_window_default_pos of the editor. The game has nine ship classes; vanilla shows seven and scrolls.

manual: Adding and removing a class, the role picker of a row
Saving a template and opening the template list: not seen in a check
checklist: Editor: class names and counts, the + row, Cancel and OK
Class picker: all nine classes without scrolling

states.name: templates
states._note: The template list opened. Not reachable by the harness: a new game has no saved template, and Save did nothing after one click, with and without a changed count. Drawn by the renderer only.
